All results relate to continuing operations. Revenue grew by 8.7% compared with the same period of 2025, driven mainly by new chilled-food contracts with regional retailers. Gross margin improved from 30.6% to 31.3% as ingredient costs stabilised during the second quarter.

Administrative expenses include one-off costs of £0.6 million relating to the consolidation of two distribution depots 1 . The effective tax rate for the period was 25.0%, in line with the statutory rate.

Notes to the condensed interim financial statements
1. Basis of preparation

These condensed interim financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the applicable standard for interim financial reporting and should be read together with the annual financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025. They do not include all the information required for full annual statements.
2. Segment information

3. Dividends

A final dividend of 6.4 pence per share for the year 2025, amounting to £3,072,000, was paid on 22 May 2026 2 . The Board has declared an interim dividend of 3.1 pence per share, payable on 30 October 2026 to shareholders on the register on 2 October 2026.
4. Borrowings

The Group repaid £2.5 million of its term loan during the period in accordance with the agreed schedule. The revolving credit facility of £20 million remained undrawn at 30 June 2026, and all financial covenants were met.
5. Events after the reporting date

On 14 August 2026 the Group signed an agreement to acquire a specialist gluten-free bakery for a consideration of £4.2 million, subject to regulatory approval. No other events requiring disclosure have occurred since the reporting date.
